answers.answer: Crafted link phrases provide the densest, most context-specific characterization because each phrase explains why the target matters within the surrounding argument. Their availability is unreliable because they require human judgment and authoring discipline; if no one writes the contextual phrase, the pointer is absent or weak.

The four forms are natural-language, symbolic, distributed-parametric, and mixed. Representational form describes how an artifact’s operative part is encoded and consumed, whereas storage substrate describes where or in what container it is stored. For example, Markdown can contain natural-language, symbolic, or mixed content, while a vector store can expose natural-language records whose retrieval relies on distributed-parametric embeddings.
